ms.promise:
Provide a public GitHub repository with the following:
・Scaffolded TypeScript-based SDK structure.
・Core endpoints for managing Collateralized Debt Positions (CDPs).
・Documentation on how to install the SDK into your own project.
ms.criteria:
・SDK structure is implemented and functional.
・CDP endpoints (open, manage, and close, redemption) are functional, allowing basic interaction with the Indigo Protocol.
・Clear, concise documentation on how to install the SDK into your own project.
ms.report:
Milestone Outputs
https://github.com/indigoprotocol/indigo-sdk - This is the open source repository for the Indigo SDK. This contains: the typescript SDK for collateralized debt position endpoints: Open, Mint/Burn/Deposit/Withdraw, and Close. Documentation in the README.md on how to install the project into your own.
Acceptance Criteria
The SDK structure is as follows:
src/ - The base project source directory
src/contracts/ - A class for each contract and it's corresponding endpoints.
src/helpers/ - Helper functions for fetching UTxOs, calculating interest, etc.
src/scripts/ - The validators to be loaded in for Indigo v2.1
src/types/ - Types for datums, validator parameters, redeemers, etc.
tests/ - The project test suite (unit tests for now)

ms.report:
Milestone Outputs
https://github.com/indigoprotocol/indigo-sdk - This is the open source repository for the Indigo SDK. This project has been updated since commit hash `6544fe8` to include endpoints for a new feature (outside the scope of this Catalyst project) called LRP, and also introduces endpoints for opening, adjusting, and closing Staking Positions and Stability Pool accounts.
Since that has, we've also included a much more comprehensive test suite that includes initializing the protocol, and doing acceptance tests (in an emulated environment) for CDPs, LRP, Staking, and Stability Pools.
Acceptance Criteria
The SDK structure is as follows:
src/ - The base project source directory
src/contracts/ - A class for each contract and it's corresponding endpoints.
src/helpers/ - Helper functions for fetching UTxOs, calculating interest, etc.
src/scripts/ - The validators to be loaded in for Indigo v2.1
src/types/ - Types for datums, validator parameters, redeemers, etc.
tests/ - The project test suite (unit tests for now)

https://github.com/IndigoProtocol/indigo-sdk/tree/main/tests - Acceptance tests for Stablility Pool and Staking Positions have been introduced here in the following files: stability-pool.test.ts and staking.test.ts.
